# Ultimate

> A full-stack, Bun-only, opinionated web framework: Rails' philosophy on a Bun + Postgres + SolidJS stack, where the primary developer is an AI agent. Everything is one of eight primitives — `entity`, `policy`, `action`, `mutator`, `query`, `job`, `route`, `task` — and one `action` declaration projects into an HTTP route, an OpenAPI operation, a typed client, a job handle, an MCP tool and a test, all on one `policy`. There is never a second authorization system. The CLI binary is `x`; every command and every error takes `--json`, and every framework error carries a stable `X_*` code, a concrete cause and the exact command that fixes it. `x verify` is the single gate: nineteen steps, green means shippable. Install with `bunx create-ultimate myapp`.

This file is a link map, not a status page. **It states no version, count or verdict without the command that resolves it** — a number written here goes stale on the next commit and the command does not. `As of 2026-08-20`.

## Resolve before you quote

- `npm view @ultimat3/core version`: what npm serves, and what `bunx create-ultimate` installs. Every `@ultimat3/*` package moves in lockstep at that one version — one commit, one tag, one publish run — so a mixed-version install is a combination nobody tested.
- `bun run scripts/list-workspaces.ts --json`: every publishable workspace with its tier and stamped version. The source the package list below is generated from.
- `bun run scripts/registry-audit.ts --json`: whether every one of those packages is on the registry at that version, each with a provenance attestation, or which are missing and how to fix it.
- `bun run scripts/release.ts --check <version>`: whether the repository is stamped at one version end to end.
- `bun run x -- verify --json`: the gate's steps in order, each with its verdict. The list is data — `VERIFY_STEP_NAMES` in [packages/cli/src/verify-step.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/cli/src/verify-step.ts).
- `bun run x -- help --json`: every command and flag this build ships, and which are registered but planned.
- `bun run manifest`: regenerates [framework.manifest.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/framework.manifest.json) — packages, tiers, and every `X_*` code with its owner and the file that declares it. Drift fails the gate.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/CLAUDE.md): the status table, one runnable check per row, plus the realtime capacity figures — the copy [scripts/bench-claims.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/scripts/bench-claims.ts) audits against the committed benchmark results. Do not restate those numbers from anywhere else.

## Where do I look for X

- **I have a task and need the loop to follow**: [docs/architecture/15-adding-a-feature.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/15-adding-a-feature.md) — entity → policy → action → query → route → test, with the exact command per step.
- **What shape does a primitive take**: [docs/idea/02-primitives.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/02-primitives.md) for the canonical declaration; [wiki/The-Eight-Primitives.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/The-Eight-Primitives.md) for the reference version.
- **Which package owns this**: the package list below, or [docs/architecture/01-package-map.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/01-package-map.md). Every package carries `README.md` (public API) beside `CLAUDE.md` (boundary, deps, commands).
- **My import failed**: [docs/architecture/02-boundaries.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/02-boundaries.md); the executable tier table is [scripts/lib/tiers.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/scripts/lib/tiers.ts). Imports go DOWN a tier only.
- **I hit an `X_*` code**: [wiki/Error-Codes.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Error-Codes.md), or `x errors explain <CODE> --json`. Run the `fix:` line verbatim — it is a command, a call to paste, or an edit naming a file.
- **A CLI flag or exit code**: [wiki/CLI-Reference.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/CLI-Reference.md).
- **Is this broken on purpose**: [wiki/Known-Gaps.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Known-Gaps.md) for named defects and unfinished seams; [wiki/Troubleshooting.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Troubleshooting.md) symptom-first.
- **What breaks when I upgrade**: [wiki/Upgrading.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Upgrading.md) — one section per major, each entry naming the manual edit. No release has ever shipped a codemod.
- **What idiomatic usage looks like**: [examples/dummy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/examples/dummy/README.md) — every primitive, once. The deployed demo with its warts is [dummy/social-media-clone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/dummy/social-media-clone/README.md).
- **How to run it in production**: [docs/ops/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/ops/README.md) — PaaS → Compose → Kubernetes, secrets, observability, runbooks. Recommendations only; the framework depends on none of it.
- **Is it the right size for my project**: [docs/idea/21-the-range.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/21-the-range.md) — homework assignment to very large product, one framework and no lite mode: the small end measured on a fresh scaffold, the large end anchored to the scale ladder, the tier boundaries and the 19-step gate, and why enforced conventions and executable `fix:` lines pay more the cheaper the model.
- **Why a decision was made**: [docs/idea/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/README.md). **How it actually works**: [docs/architecture/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/README.md).
- **The rules I must not break while editing this repo**: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/CLAUDE.md) and [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/AGENTS.md); the full coding contract is [docs/architecture/00-conventions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/00-conventions.md).
- **How to cut a breaking release**: [docs/architecture/19-cutting-a-major.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/19-cutting-a-major.md), then [PUBLISHING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/PUBLISHING.md).

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/README.md): the entry point — what it is, how to run it, the package table, the gate, and one hop to everything else.
- [Thesis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/00-thesis.md): the eight design axioms, the inspire-explicitly table, the permanent exclusions. Read before arguing with a default.
- [The eight primitives](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/02-primitives.md): canonical shape and rules for each. Read before writing any app code. A new capability arrives as a factory over an existing primitive — `llm()` returns an action, `backfill()` returns a job — never as a ninth kind.
- [Adding a feature](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/15-adding-a-feature.md): the end-to-end walkthrough an agent should follow.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/CLAUDE.md): boundaries, dependencies, commands and non-negotiables for working inside this repo.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/AGENTS.md): short, human-authored conventions an agent cannot infer. Never generated.
- [Docs index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/README.md): the map of idea, architecture and ops docs.

## The gate

- `x verify` runs nineteen steps in cost order, and the framework repo and a generated app run exactly that list, whole: `typecheck`, `lint`, `boundaries`, `filesize`, `package-shape`, `errors`, `unit`, `contract`, `live`, `job`, `e2e`, `eval`, `drift`, `contract-diff`, `budgets`, `seo`, `i18n`, `manifest`, `roadmap`. `x verify --only <step>` runs one step for an iteration loop and announces `NOT A GATE RUN` in both the summary and `--json`; the gate is the command with no flag, and there is no `--skip`.
- In this repo the gate is `bun run verify`; both tracked apps run their own on a ratchet with `bun run scripts/reference-app-gate.ts`.
- [Testing internals](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/14-testing-internals.md): the six test types, template-DB cloning, the frozen clock, the sealed network, and the exact order of the gate.
- [wiki/Testing.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Testing.md): the reference version, including how to write each test type.

## Packages

Generated from `bun run scripts/list-workspaces.ts --json` and each package's own `description`. A package may import only from a STRICTLY LOWER tier — never sideways unless the edge is declared, never upward; a violation is a build error (`bun run boundaries`). Declared sideways edges: `realtime -> query`, `cli -> admin`, `cli -> testing`, `create-ultimate -> cli`.

- [@ultimat3/core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/core/README.md): tier 0 — Ultimate's foundation: errors, context, env, config, clock, ids, logging, telemetry, lifecycle. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/core/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/schema/README.md): tier 0 — Ultimate's validation seam: Standard Schema interface, the t namespace, JSON Schema output. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/schema/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/cache](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/cache/README.md): tier 1 — Tagged caching: request memo, LRU, Redis, CDN — one invalidation graph. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/cache/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/db](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/db/README.md): tier 1 — Postgres access, transactions, migrations and drift detection. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/db/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/flags](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/flags/README.md): tier 1 — Feature flags: permanent switches, and temporary ones that cannot be forgotten. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/flags/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/i18n](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/i18n/README.md): tier 1 — Dependency-free translator, catalog flattening, locale negotiation and loud missing-key rendering. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/i18n/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/money](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/money/README.md): tier 1 — Integer minor units with an attached currency: arithmetic, allocation, rounding, Intl formatting. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/money/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/seo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/seo/README.md): tier 1 — Enforced SEO: typed meta, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots, feeds, responsive images, perf budgets. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/seo/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/storage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/storage/README.md): tier 1 — Named disks over Bun.file and Bun.s3: safe keys, signed URLs, sniffed uploads. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/storage/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/time](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/time/README.md): tier 1 — UTC instants, DST-correct zone math, cron, durations and Intl formatting with an explicit timezone. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/time/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/auth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/auth/README.md): tier 2 — Sessions, passwords, OAuth, MFA and api keys — resolved to one Actor. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/auth/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/entity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/entity/README.md): tier 2 — A table + its domain type + invariants the database also enforces. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/entity/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/http](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/http/README.md): tier 2 — Owned request lifecycle over Bun.serve: router, ordered pipeline, problem+json errors. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/http/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/policy/README.md): tier 2 — The one authz rule, evaluated identically in every surface. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/policy/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/action/README.md): tier 3 — The action primitive: one declaration projected to route, OpenAPI, client, MCP tool, job handle, tests. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/action/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/jobs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/jobs/README.md): tier 3 — Durable background work: steps, transactional outbox, cron tasks, one driver interface. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/jobs/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/query](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/query/README.md): tier 3 — The query primitive: a policy-checked read, optionally live, with cursor pagination and an incremental matcher. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/query/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/realtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/realtime/README.md): tier 3 — Three-tier realtime: channels, live queries, local-first sync — one protocol, one mutator shape. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/realtime/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/ai](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/ai/README.md): tier 4 — LLM gateway, versioned prompts, evals as tests, embeddings, hybrid vector search, RAG. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/ai/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/mail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/mail/README.md): tier 4 — Transactional email as data: one template renders HTML and text, sent through a job. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/mail/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/manifest/README.md): tier 4 — x.manifest.json: deterministic generated facts, contract diff, AGENTS.md budget. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/manifest/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/mcp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/mcp/README.md): tier 4 — MCP server, dev tools, and the action-to-tool projection — one authz system, two surfaces. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/mcp/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/pwa](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/pwa/README.md): tier 4 — Generated service worker, web manifest, icons, push and version-skew handling. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/pwa/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/render](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/render/README.md): tier 4 — The route primitive and the five render modes: static, isr, ssr, stream, spa. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/render/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/ui/README.md): tier 4 — SolidJS design system: semantic design tokens, dark/RTL-ready SCSS modules, a11y primitives. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/ui/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/admin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/admin/README.md): tier 5 — Two dashboards: the /_x framework dev panels and the generated, AI-first app admin. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/admin/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/cli](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/cli/README.md): tier 5 — The `x` binary: new, dev, build, verify, generate, db, mcp, doctor, deploy. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/cli/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/scraping](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/scraping/README.md): tier 5 — Browser automation as a job: scrape() returns a JobHandle. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/scraping/CLAUDE.md).
- [@ultimat3/testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/testing/README.md): tier 5 — Test harness: cloned template DBs per worker, frozen clock, sealed network, 6 test types. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/testing/CLAUDE.md).
- [create-ultimate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/create-ultimate/README.md): tier 6 — bunx create-ultimate myapp — scaffold an Ultimate monorepo. Boundary and deps: [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/create-ultimate/CLAUDE.md).


## Primitives, in source

- [entity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/entity/src/index.ts): table + domain type + invariants; projects to parameterised SQL, migrations and admin screens. No ORM — `postgresDriver()` and `memoryDriver()` share one plan and one cursor codec.
- [policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/policy/src/index.ts): `can(permission, predicate)`, evaluated identically in HTTP, WS, jobs and MCP.
- [action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/action/src/index.ts): the server-authoritative mutation, and the six artifacts one declaration projects.
- [query](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/query/src/index.ts): a policy-checked read, optionally `live: true`; requires deterministic, bounded SQL, and a live query's sort key has to be readable on the row it returns.
- [job](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/jobs/src/index.ts): durable steps, a required idempotency key, the transactional outbox, and `backfill()` as a job factory. `handle` is at-least-once — an attempt cancelled before its checkpoint replays that page, so a handler must be idempotent.
- [route](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/render/src/index.ts): `defineRoute`, the five render modes, hydration timing, budgets.
- [realtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/realtime/src/index.ts): channels, live-query transport, mutator rebase, cursors. Tiers 1–2 ship; tier 3 local-first (`persist: true`) is deferred behind the same interfaces. Capacity is measured on ONE node and the audited figures live in `CLAUDE.md`.
- [registrar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/core/src/registrar.ts): `PRIMITIVE_KINDS` — the single source the eight derive from, pinned by a test. A ninth entry is a failing test.


## Design — docs/idea

- [00-thesis.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/00-thesis.md): Rails' philosophy, but the primary developer is an AI agent — plus the inspire-explicitly table and the 8 axioms.
- [01-stack.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/01-stack.md): One locked choice per layer; Bun natives delete ~40 dependencies before you write a line.
- [02-primitives.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/02-primitives.md): Eight primitives. `action` projects to six artifacts. Two authz systems is how every Meteor-like framework died.
- [03-realtime.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/03-realtime.md): Channels → live queries → local-first: a ladder, not three products. Tier 2 → 3 is `persist: true` on a **query** — never a config key: `realtime.tier` was read by nothing and was deleted in 10.0.0.
- [04-jobs.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/04-jobs.md): Transactional outbox by default, durable steps, idempotency key required by the type.
- [05-caching.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/05-caching.md): Four tiers, one invalidation graph. `invalidates: [tag.post]` reaches memo, LRU, Redis, ISR, and the CDN in one hop.
- [06-surfaces.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/06-surfaces.md): `site/` cannot import `app/` — a build error, because that import is how marketing pages ship charting libraries.
- [07-rendering-seo.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/07-rendering-seo.md): Five render modes; `stream` is the app default. SEO is enforced, not documented.
- [08-pwa-offline.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/08-pwa-offline.md): `sw.js` is emitted, never hand-edited. Version skew is what actually breaks PWAs.
- [09-ai-first.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/09-ai-first.md): The differentiator: MCP dev server, generated facts, and apps whose own dashboards expose MCP.
- [10-testing.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/10-testing.md): One cloned Postgres database per worker, sealed network, frozen clock. Parallel is opt-in, and says so.
- [11-topology.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/11-topology.md): One image, six roles, graceful drain that redistributes sockets instead of stampeding.
- [12-build-deploy.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/12-build-deploy.md): `x build --target docker|binary|static`. Deploy target = "runs containers". Nothing else.
- [13-dx.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/13-dx.md): First 60 seconds: no Docker, no env scavenger hunt, sub-second HMR that keeps state.
- [14-roadmap.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/14-roadmap.md): 12 milestones, each ending in a working demo app + green `x verify`. Ship 0–5 before realtime.
- [15-risks.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/15-risks.md): Six risks, honestly sized. The sync engine is ~70% of the effort.
- [16-app-targets.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/16-app-targets.md): Web, mobile, desktop from one definition. A screen is a `route`, not a ninth primitive. Design only.
- [17-scale-ladder.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/17-scale-ladder.md): PaaS to distributed in five rungs, where climbing is config and drivers — never a rewrite. Rungs 0–2 are real and 24 of the 26 seam rows are shipped; the doc names every place the invariant breaks today.
- [18-build-vs-wrap.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/18-build-vs-wrap.md): Own the integration layer, wrap the protocol layer. Verdicts: jobs BUILD, SMTP BUILD, NATS WRAP — adopted, `nats@2.29.3` at the transport seam.
- [19-mechanism-not-convention.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/19-mechanism-not-convention.md): Axiom 8. Mechanisms and structural conventions ship; business conventions never do. Tenancy ships, an org model does not — the app wraps.
- [20-large-app-readiness.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/20-large-app-readiness.md): The capability axis: what a very large app already gets, and whether a company can plug its own infrastructure in. The primitives are enterprise-grade; the dominant defect is a mechanism built, exported, and never called by the boot — the outbox, the scheduler watermark, the shared cache tier, WebSocket auth.
- [21-the-range.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/idea/21-the-range.md): Who it is for, and the range — a homework assignment to a very large product, one framework, no lite mode. The small end measured on a fresh scaffold; the large end anchored to the ladder, the tiers and the gate; and why enforced conventions pay more with a cheap model.

## Internals — docs/architecture

- [00-conventions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/00-conventions.md): File layout, naming, export surface, LOC ceilings — the rules Biome and `x verify` enforce.
- [01-package-map.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/01-package-map.md): 29 packages, 6 tiers, one reason to change each. What every package owns and must never do.
- [02-boundaries.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/02-boundaries.md): Tier violations are build errors. `scripts/boundaries.ts` resolves the transitive chain and prints it.
- [03-request-lifecycle.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/03-request-lifecycle.md): 17 ordered stages and why each sits where it does. ALS context, so no layer threads `actor`.
- [04-error-contract.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/04-error-contract.md): `UltimateError`: one object, three renderings. Every error carries an executable `fix:`.
- [05-type-chain.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/05-type-chain.md): DB column → entity → action → OpenAPI → client → component. Rename a field, count the compile errors.
- [06-data-layer.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/06-data-layer.md): Entities, repos, tenancy. Cursor pagination only. Migrations that cannot lie.
- [07-realtime-internals.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/07-realtime-internals.md): WAL → change feed → matcher → fanout → patch. Per-subscriber policy, reconnect cost model.
- [08-jobs-internals.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/08-jobs-internals.md): Memoized step replay, the real `SKIP LOCKED` claim SQL, lease-row leader election.
- [09-rendering-internals.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/09-rendering-internals.md): Two bundle graphs, the streaming envelope, four hydration strategies, ISR single-flight.
- [10-cross-cutting.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/10-cross-cutting.md): i18n, theming, timezones, money — four concerns, enforced rather than documented.
- [11-ai-surface.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/11-ai-surface.md): One `evaluate`, two adapters. Hidden tools answer `ToolNotFound`, never `Forbidden`.
- [12-generated-app.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/12-generated-app.md): What `x new` emits, why each directory exists, and how it grows to mobile without restructuring.
- [13-topology-runtime.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/13-topology-runtime.md): One image, six roles. Drain sequencing, `/healthz` vs `/readyz`, version skew.
- [14-testing-internals.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/14-testing-internals.md): Template-DB cloning, frozen clock, sealed network, and the exact order of `x verify`.
- [15-adding-a-feature.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/15-adding-a-feature.md): The end-to-end walkthrough with the exact command per step. Read this one most.
- [16-build-pipeline.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/16-build-pipeline.md): SCSS modules → scoped CSS, the server render path, and what the budgets gate now measures. There is still no client bundle — the page says why.
- [17-uploads.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/17-uploads.md): Signed direct upload: who signs, who verifies, where bytes land, and what sweeps the orphans.
- [18-observer-seam.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/18-observer-seam.md): The two funnels every statement passes through, attribution, and why an uninstalled diagnostic costs production one branch.
- [19-cutting-a-major.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/19-cutting-a-major.md): One `wiki/Upgrading.md` section per major, written when the first breaking change lands. What `CHANGELOG.md` owns, what the wiki owns, and which of the three rules nothing enforces.

## Operations — docs/ops

Recommendations, not requirements: the framework depends on none of it (axiom 7, deploy anywhere = containers only).

- [Operations index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/ops/README.md): the PaaS → Compose → Kubernetes ladder, and what each rung costs.
- [01-kubernetes.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/ops/01-kubernetes.md): the exact manifests an Ultimate app needs, and how GitOps applies them.
- [02-secrets.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/ops/02-secrets.md): how a secret reaches a pod without ever being committed in plaintext.
- [03-observability.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/ops/03-observability.md): what to scrape, what to alert on, what Ultimate does not emit yet.
- [04-datastores.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/ops/04-datastores.md): Postgres, Dragonfly and NATS in production — real sizing, real failure modes.
- [05-disaster-recovery.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/ops/05-disaster-recovery.md): backups you can restore, and the key without which they are noise.
- [06-runbooks.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/ops/06-runbooks.md): rollback, stuck deploys, image-pull failures, a leaked credential.

## CLI

- [CLI reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/CLI-Reference.md): every `x` command, flag and exit code, with `--json` examples. Start here.
- [cli source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/cli/src/registry.ts): `SPECS` is the command registry — the list `x help --json` prints and the list every doc is checked against.
- `x new <name>` / `bunx create-ultimate <name>`: scaffold the monorepo, every `@ultimat3/*` dependency pinned to one exact version. `x dev`: embedded Postgres, in-process NATS, MCP dev server, `/_x` dashboard.
- `x g resource|action|mutator|backfill|job|route|policy|entity|query|task|island|admin:page|guard <name>`: generators that emit code plus real, typed test files — never a TODO stub.
- `x db gen "<name>" | migrate | reset | seed | studio | branch | backfill`: migrations, seeds and branch databases. Drift is a gate failure.
- `x jobs`, `x tasks`, `x routes`, `x actions`, `x queries`, `x entities`, `x policy`, `x manifest`, `x errors explain <CODE>`, `x docs "<question>"`: introspection, all with `--json`.
- `x build --target docker|binary|static`, `x deploy --image <ref> [--method compose|helm]`, `x doctor`, `x test`, `x env`, `x secrets`, `x i18n`, `x fix`, `x mcp`.
- Nine commands are registered and labelled planned — [cmd-planned.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/cli/src/cmd-planned.ts). Each exits `X_NOT_IMPLEMENTED` with a `fix:` naming the closest shipped command, never `X_CLI_UNKNOWN_COMMAND`: "not built yet" and "not a command" are different facts. `x upgrade` is one of them, so the upgrade path today is `bun update --latest && x verify` plus the manual edits [wiki/Upgrading.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Upgrading.md) names.

## Error codes

- [Error codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Error-Codes.md): every `X_*` code with its meaning, cause and fix command. Consult this first.
- [Error registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/core/src/error-codes.ts): code → title → docs URL, with duplicate detection.
- [UltimateError](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/packages/core/src/errors.ts): the one error type — `{ code, cause, fix, docs }`, identical in the terminal, the browser overlay and `--json`.
- [The error contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/docs/architecture/04-error-contract.md): one object, three renderings, and why every `fix:` must be executable.
- Rendered shape: `X_DB_DRIFT: schema differs from migrations` / `cause: …` / `fix: x db gen "add publish_at"`. Run the `fix` line verbatim.
- A shipped code never changes meaning and is never reused. `x errors explain <CODE> --json` and the MCP `errors.explain` tool return the same content.

## Examples

- [examples/dummy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/examples/dummy/README.md): the reference app — every primitive, once, idiomatically.
- [examples/dummy/app.config.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/examples/dummy/app.config.ts): the one config file, every field in context.
- [examples/dummy/AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/examples/dummy/AGENTS.md): what a generated app tells its agents.
- [dummy/social-media-clone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/dummy/social-media-clone/README.md): the deployed demo. Read it with [its own gate pins](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/scripts/lib/gated-apps.ts) — each pinned step is a named, deliberate red.

## Wiki — the reference manual

The single public documentation surface; there is no separate marketing site. Source of truth is `wiki/` in this repo, mirrored to the GitHub wiki on merge. Browsable: https://github.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/wiki

- [Home](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Home.md): the full wiki index, with a reading path per audience.


- [Actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Actions.md): every field, the six generated artifacts, the mutator twin, contract tests.
- [Admin dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Admin-Dashboard.md): the generated admin app and its MCP surface.
- [Agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Agents.md): `agent()` as an action factory, tools as real actions, `hive()`, `agentJob()`, and the at-least-once trap.
- [Batching and preloading](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Batching-And-Preloading.md): JIT preload, `.preload()`, `insertAll`/`upsertAll`/`updateWhere`, `inBatches`, the tenancy guarantee.
- [Building your own base](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Building-Your-Own-Base.md): wrap a primitive in your own factory: `tenantEntity`, `auditedMutator`, the two caveats, and why nothing downstream notices.
- [CLI reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/CLI-Reference.md): every `x` command and flag, with `--json` examples.
- [Caching and invalidation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Caching-And-Invalidation.md): four tiers, one tag graph, one-hop fanout.
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Configuration.md): every `app.config.ts` field and every env var.
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Contributing.md): package layout, import tiers, conventions, PR expectations.
- [Deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Deployment.md): one image, six roles, `ROLE`/`PORT`, drain, compose, Helm, targets, `docs/ops/`.
- [Entities and migrations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Entities-And-Migrations.md): tables, invariants, tenancy, `x db gen`, drift, branch databases.
- [Error codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Error-Codes.md): every `X_*` code: meaning, cause, exact fix.
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/FAQ.md): why Bun only, why no GraphQL, is it production ready.

- [Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Installation.md): prerequisites, `x new`, typed env, editor and MCP client setup.
- [Jobs and workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Jobs-And-Workflows.md): transactional outbox, durable steps, idempotency, drivers.
- [Known gaps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Known-Gaps.md): every defect and unfinished seam in the published release, named.
- [MCP and AI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/MCP-And-AI.md): the dev MCP server, every action as a tool, the `llm()` gateway, evals.

- [Money](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Money.md): `Money = { minor, currency }`, never a float.
- [N+1 detection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/N-Plus-One-Detection.md): the two codes, `expectedQueryLoop`, four surfaces, why prod pays nothing.

- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Testing.md): six test types, cloned databases, sealed network, `x verify`.
- [The eight primitives](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/The-Eight-Primitives.md): `entity`, `policy`, `action`, `mutator`, `query`, `job`, `route`, `task` — the whole vocabulary.
- [Theming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Theming.md): 24 semantic colour roles as RGB channels, every token scale, `defineTheme()`, what contrast is gated.
- [Timezones and dates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Timezones-And-Dates.md): store UTC, format with an explicit IANA zone, frozen clocks in tests.
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ultimate/main/wiki/Troubleshooting.md): symptom → cause → fix.
